ui.chat.aside.aside_panel.off_the_record: off the record — nothing here joins the conversation
ui.chat.aside.aside_panel.question: Question:
ui.chat.aside.aside_panel.type_a_questio: Type a question in the composer below — the answer lands here.
ui.chat.aside.aside.the_aside_was_not_ad: The aside was not added to the conversation.
ui.chat.aside.aside.the_exchange_is_stil: The exchange is still settling — a moment before it can be added.
ui.chat.aside.aside.the_model_didnt_repl: The model didn't reply in text. Ask again.
ui.chat.aside.aside.this_conversation_is: This conversation is working. Adding the aside while it runs would splice a message into a live turn.
ui.chat.aside.aside_panel.add_the_aside_: Add the aside to the conversation
ui.chat.aside.aside.ask_again_here_to_ke: Ask again here to keep this exchange, or press Esc to close the aside and discard it.

ui.chat.aside.aside.the_aside_could_not_: The aside could not be confirmed in the conversation. If it is not there, add it again.
ui.chat.aside.aside.the_aside_is_still_a: The aside is still answering. Press Enter again once the answer is in.
ui.chat.aside.aside.the_aside_was_not_ad: The aside was not added to the conversation. Add it again to try once more.
ui.chat.aside.aside.this_aside_cant_cont: This aside can't continue. Press Esc to close it, which discards this exchange, then start a new one with /btw.
ui.chat.aside.aside.this_aside_is_queued: This aside is queued to join the conversation. Ask again once it has been added.
ui.chat.aside.aside.press_asideadoptcapv: Press {asideAdoptCapValue} again to add the aside to the conversation. Once added, it stays there.
ui.chat.aside.aside.the_aside_was_not_ad: The aside was not added: this conversation has closed, so there is nothing to add it to.
ui.chat.aside.aside.the_conversation_sto: The conversation stopped in the middle of a tool call, so the aside was not added. Send a message to continue the conversation, then add the aside.
ui.chat.aside.aside.this_conversation_is: This conversation is busy, and the version it's running can't queue an aside. Add it when the reply finishes.
